body:
Hey, seems like this is getting quite into detail and I can't replicate the differing count. I always see 33 333 results. Can you send an email to [support@algolia.com](mailto:support@algolia.com) with two queries that should have the same number of result but don't? You can look in the devtools tab, and "copy as curl" the two `queries` results that have different results, but shouldn't. 

I'll close this issue since I don't think it's related to instantsearch.js, but rather something else in the API call.
